name: boardcheck-edge
description: Unfinished prototype, never launched: an experiment with a hosted, pay-per-use version of Boardcheck (AMS-001..AMS-005 listing checks with a Remote MCP endpoint). Its draft Solana Pay credits were never offered or sold; do not send payments. This prototype must not be deployed: its payment check accepts any confirmed Solana transaction that did not fail, whatever the amount or recipient. The maintained project is https://github.com/Echolonius/boardcheck.

pricing.note: Draft prices from src/payment/solana.ts. Nothing was ever offered or sold, and a payment would get you nothing. Do not send SOL or USDC to any address.

freeTier.description: Draft only: the code gives a 100-credit trial key on a server you run yourself. No service ever offered one.

tools.name: boardcheck_scan_listings
tools.description: Audit a batch of job/bounty listings for synthetic activity and non-payment risks (AMS-001..AMS-005).

listings.description: Array of listing objects containing view counts, bid counts, budgets, and escrow flags.

tools.name: boardcheck_verify_single_task
tools.description: Pre-flight risk assessment for an individual task before spending LLM tokens or delivering code.

tools.description: Retrieve exact specifications, detection logic, and false-positive mitigations for AMS standards.
